title: Is the 4% Retirement Rule Dead? New Strategies for Gen Z and Millennials in India
seoTitle: 4% Rule in India: Is It Dead? Safer Retirement Plans
seoDescription: What the 4% retirement rule means in rupees, why 3–3.5% is safer with Indian inflation, how much corpus you need, and where EPF, PPF, NPS and SWP fit.
excerpt: Works through the 4% withdrawal rule in rupees, shows why Indian inflation makes a 3–3.5% start safer, and sets out a retirement plan built on EPF, PPF, NPS, SCSS and mutual fund SWPs.
